{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data structure
print("Data shape:", sales_df.shape)
print("\nColumn types:")
print(sales_df.dtypes)

# Check for missing values
print("\nMissing values:")
print(sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check unique values in key columns
print("\nUnique values in status:")
print(sales_df['status'].value_counts())

print("\nUnique values in channel:")
print(sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

print("\nUnique values in customer_segment:")
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check the revenue column — it's stored as string
print("\nSample of revenue values:")
print(sales_df['revenue'].head())"}
